paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who built the Hyderabad State?
x: Sultan Quli Qutb Shah established the Qutb Shahi kingdom in 1512 with Golconda as its capital. Mohammed Quli Qutb Shah was the founder of Hyderabad city.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Which area caused a conflict between Nizam Ali, the ruler of Hyderabad, and the British?
x: Nizam Ali Khan asked the British for help against the Marathas but they refused. The British tried to acquire the Northern Circars without the Nizam's interference.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: What does 'moturbha' refer to?
x: Moturbha was a tax on handlooms imposed by the British, weakening the indigenous handloom industry.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Wahabi movement is like:
x: The Wahabi movement in Hyderabad, part of the revolt of 1857 against the British, was led by Nasir Ud-doula.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Palegars in Rayala Seema were suppressed by whome?
x: Sir Thomas Munro, Collector of the Dattata Mandalam (1800-1807), suppressed the Palegars with the help of Captain Campbell. He abolished the Palegar system and introduced the Ryotwari system.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who has contributed significantly to the development of education in Andhra?
x: In 1843 the Church Missionary Society established a school for the first time in Andhra at Machilipatnam under the educationist Noble. By 1864 it had grown to a college.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Year of Rampa Revolution:
x: The Rampa rebellion led by Chandraya, Pulikanta Sambaiah, Tammanna Dora and others arose over the Munsabdar's conditions on toddy and taxes. Chandraya was killed by the British in February 1880.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Which town is the functional area of Datta mandalam area?
x: Until 1808, Anantapur was the main center of Datta Mandalam. Kadapa and Bellary districts (1808), Kurnool (1858), Anantapur (1852) and Chittoor (1911) were formed from it.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: The first Telugu novel by Veeresalingam in Telugu literature?
x: Rajasekhara Charitra is the first novel in Telugu. It is based on Oliver Goldsmith's 'Vicar of Wakefield'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who established a school in Machilipatnam in 1843 AD?
x: The Church Missionary Society established a school for the first time in Andhra in 1843 at Machilipatnam under the leadership of the western educationist Noble. It grew to a college by 1864.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Hyderabad Nizam College was established in which year?
x: The Nizam College was established in 1887 during the reign of the sixth Asaf Jahi Nizam Mahbub Ali Khan.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: What was the first Telugu magazine published from Ballary?
x: The first magazine published in Telugu was the monthly 'Satyadutha', published in 1835 from Madras under the auspices of the Bellary Christian Society.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: When was the gentlemen agreement?
x: On 20 February 1956 the leaders of Andhra and Telangana met in Delhi and made the Gentlemen's Agreement. A total of 8 members participated and a 14-point agreement was made.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who organized Bipin Chandrapal's tour in Andhra?
x: In April 1907, Mutnuru Krishna Rao organized Bipin Chandrapal's visit to spread the Vande Mataram movement in Andhra. His lectures were translated into Telugu by Chilakamarthi Lakshminarasimham.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Under whose Leadership Peasant and Agrarian Movements takes place in Andhra?
x: N.G. Ranga established the Indian Farmer Training Center at Nidubrolu in 1934 and organized the peasant movement in Venkatagiri zamindari in 1933-36. His title was Rythu Bandhu.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: When was National College established at Machilipatnam?
x: Bipin Chandrapal laid the foundation stone of the National College at Machilipatnam in 1907; it was opened on 27 March 1910 as the Bander National College.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who led the anti-alcohol and swadeshi movements in Dattamandalas?
x: Kalluri Subbarao, the grand old man of Rayalaseema, led anti-alcohol and swadeshi movements in Dattamandals.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who started the English daily "Swarajya"?
x: In 1921 Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu started the Swarajya daily newspaper.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p1
s: Who was the first Vice Chancellor of Andhra University?
x: Dr. Kattamanchi Ramalinga Reddy (C.R. Reddy) was appointed the first Vice-Chancellor of Andhra University, started on April 28, 1926 in Vijayawada.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who translated Maxim Gorky's 'Mother' into Telugu?
x: Maxim Gorky's novel 'The Mother' was translated by Krovvidi Lingaraju as 'AMMA'.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who was the first Telugu person to preside over the Indian National Congress?
x: Anandacharya presided over the Nagpur session of the Indian National Congress in 1891.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who presided over the first session of the "Nizam Andhra Mahasabha"?
x: Suravaram Prathapa Reddy presided over the first meeting of the Nizam Andhra Mahasabha.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: In which year Sri Krishnarayandhra Bhasha Nilayam was established?
x: Komarraju Lakshmana Rao, with Ravichettu Ranga Rao, Munagala Raja and others, founded the first Telugu library 'Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam' in 1901.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who was the first elected Chief Minister of Hyderabad state?
x: Burgula Ramakrishna Rao served as the first Hyderabad Chief Minister (1952-1956). He later served as Governor of Kerala and Uttar Pradesh.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who was the leader of the Rajakars?
x: Kasim Razvi was the leader of the Razakars, the Nizam's private army.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who was the first Chief Minister in the Justice Party government in Madras state?
x: In the 1920 elections the Justice Party won 63 of 98 seats and formed the first democratic government in Madras Presidency. Subbarayalu Reddiyar was elected its first Chief Minister.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: First President of Andhra Congress Circle?
x: The Andhra Rashtra Congress Committee was formed on 22 January 1918 with Pattabhi Sitaramaiah playing a major role. Its first president was Nyapati Subbarao and secretary Konda Venkatappayya.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who was the first Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra State?
x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was the first Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra State. Tanguturi Prakasam was its first Chief Minister.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who wrote "History of Indian National Congress"?
x: Dr. Pattabhi Sitaramaiah wrote The History of Indian National Congress; his other works include Feathers and Stones and Gandhiji & Gandhism.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who is the editor of 'Andhra Prakasika' magazine?
x: The first political magazine 'Andhra Prakasika' was founded by Parthasarathy Naidu in 1885.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Who was the Chief Minister of Madras Presidency in 1937?
x: In the 1937 elections held under the Government of India Act 1935, C. Rajagopalachari was elected Chief Minister of Madras Presidency.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Dattamandalas are named as 'Rayala Seema' by?
x: At the 1928 Nandyala Andhra Mahasabha presided over by S. Radhakrishnan, Gadicharla Harisarvottama Rao named the Datta mandal as Rayalaseema.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: "Samastha Gandharva Vidyakovida" Chellava was whose court singer?
x: In Chalukya Bhima's court there was a dancer named Challava who was an expert in Gandharva vidya.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Which is the capital of Andhra state?
x: Kurnool was the capital of Andhra State.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: Identify the wrong Pair in the below following?
x: Among the branches of Chaityaka Buddhism, Rajagirika was at Guntupalli while Siddharthika was at Gudivada.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p3
s: Which of the following is correct regarding the period of the Satavahanas?
o: The family is matriarchal, but the kingdom is patriarchal
x: Society during the Satavahanas had a patriarchal system and kings passed inheritance to their sons, so kingship was also patriarchal. Women nonetheless had a respectable position.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p3
s: Venkateswara University was established in which year?
x: Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu, first Chief Minister of Andhra State, established Sri Venkateswara University at Tirupati in 1954. S. Govindarajulu Naidu was its first Vice-Chancellor.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p2
s: The Treaty of Sribagh was happened in which year?
x: On November 16, 1937 a meeting between the leaders of Andhra and Rayalaseema was held at Kashinadhuni Nageswara Rao's Madras residence 'Sri Bagh'. The agreement was made to protect the interests of the people of Rayalaseema.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p3
s: Who was the first Governor of Andhra Pradesh?
x: C.M. Trivedi was the first Governor of Andhra State.

paper: Paper-II Social & Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p3
s: Editor of Urdu daily 'Rayyat'?
x: Mandamula Narsinga Rao was the editor of the Urdu daily 'Rayyat'.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: During whose reign Gautami Balashri given the Nasik Inscription?
x: The Nasik Prashasti inscription was given by Gautamiputra Satakarni's mother Gautami Balashri in the 19th regnal year of Vasishtiputra Pulomavi-II. It describes the victories of Gautamiputra Satakarni.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: The king who wore the title of 'Kavi Vatsala'?
x: Hala himself was a poet and patronized many poets. He got the title of 'Kavivatsala'.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: According to Rushabhadatta's Nasik edict, what was the rate of interest during the Satavahana period?
x: The Nasik inscription mentions Rishabhadatta, son-in-law of Nahapana, who deposited gold coins at Kolika Shreni and earned 12% interest.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: What is the meaning of the word "Gulmika" mentioned in the Macedonian inscription?
x: Under the Satavahanas, a group of several villages was called a Gulma. The book's explanation says Gulmika refers to military commanders appointed to protect the border areas.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: Jain philosopher who wrote the text Samayasara?
x: The famous Jain Konda Kundacharya wrote Pravachanasara, Niyamasara, Samayasara and Panchastikaya Sara. He authored more than 84 texts in Prakrit.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: Which Jataka literature showing the defeat of Kalinga Kharavela by the Asmaka king Satakarni?
x: Asmakadheesa's victory over the Kalinga ruler mentioned in the Chulla Kalinga Jataka can be considered as the first Satakarni's victory over Kharavela.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: Inculcating religious thought in the minds of disciples as the duty of teachers is found in the inscription of Ashoka?
x: In the Erragudi edicts of Ashoka it is stated that it should be the duty of the Gurus to inculcate spiritual thoughts in the minds of the students.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: During whose reign Buddhism received great patronage in the Ikshvaku kingdom?
x: Veera Purushadatta, originally a Vedic devotee, embraced Buddhism; his reign was the golden age of Andhra Buddhism. He was known as 'Dakshinadi Ashoka'.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: Chaitya referred to as Siddharaka Chaitya in "Buddhist Vajmaya" was once identified as being here?
x: Among the branches of Chaityaka Buddhism, Siddharthika was at Gudivada.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: Which Chalukya king built 108 Shiva temples named Narendra Mrigeswaralayas?
x: Vijayaditya-II fought 108 wars in twelve years with his brother Bhimasala and built 108 Narendra Mrigeswara temples as penance.

paper: Paper-II
source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p12
s: Which king is said to have developed Kandukuru like Bejavada?
x: Gunaga Vijayaditya (Vijayaditya-III)'s general Panduranga developed Kandukuru as a town on the lines of Bejawada.
